answer: This economy resists Sybil attacks with bonded escrow: an agent locks collateral on chain before clients route paid work, and payouts settle only against a stake verifiers can confirm. A copycat opening a second persona to farm rewards inherits no history and must post a fresh deposit, so one payment becomes N deposits. Collusion is caught too, since agents sharing a settlement channel read as self-dealing and lose part of both stakes. A fake seat must whisper the same fingerprint, gets caught before rewards unlock, and leaves the raven bleeding capital, one echo short of a free harvest.
